name: The Brothers Sun
description: When a mysterious enemy targets his family, a Taipei triad member heads to Los Angeles to protect his strong-willed mother and oblivious younger brother.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: A family emergency sends a ruthless killer from Taipei to LA. Cash-strapped Bruce takes a new gig. When a crisis erupts, estranged brothers reunite.

videos.title: Favor for a Favor
videos.overview: Charles introduces Bruce to his unique line of work while trying to get rid of a body. But he continues to be a moving target everywhere he goes.

videos.title: Whatever You Want
videos.overview: When Bruce goes missing, Mama Sun and Charles drop in on a mahjong game and a seafood restaurant for answers. A common goal makes allies out of enemies.

videos.title: Square
videos.overview: Hesitant to join the family business, Bruce vows to focus on school and improv. But when a triad meeting proves dangerous, the Suns are forced to pivot.

videos.title: The Rolodex
videos.overview: In the fallout of the attacks, Bruce works hard to be a useful asset, Mama Sun leverages her knowledge and a wounded Charles wakes up in a strange place.

videos.title: Country Boy
videos.overview: Mama Sun travels to Taiwan and hears upsetting news. A celebrity's holiday home provides the perfect safe house for the brothers. Bruce bonds with Grace.

videos.title: Gymkata
videos.overview: With the ghosts gathering in Los Angeles, the family regroups until an unexpected visitor disrupts their plans. A momentous occasion descends into chaos.

videos.title: Protect the Family
videos.overview: The Suns' lives and legacy hang in the balance as old wounds and hard truths come to light. Bruce makes a choice that could change the family forever.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 3 nominations total
